Secure your trailer and protect it from theft with the Hitch Pin Lock. Unlike other products in the market this lock fits perpendicular to the pin, making it easier to access and use. The push button locking mechanism allows you to lock it without the key, making it very easy to use. The lock cylinder is also multi-functional as it can be used to secure the popular Minn Kota Electric boat motors. The hitch pin is suitable for most trailer hitches including boat, jet ski and caravan hitches. Locking the hitch pin provides extra security for locked trailers and caravans while parking at boat ramps or unsecure parking areas. The lock also features a plastic cap to provide maximum water and dust resistance. 
Features & Benefits 
• Quality stainless steel for strength & durability 
• Towing rating of 3500kg 
• 16mm hitch pin 
• Includes cotter spring pin 
• Plastic cap to protect against dust & water 
• Can also be used to secure Minn Kota Electric Motors
